rateLimits.note: Unauthenticated client with a compliant User-Agent (bot) or browser: 200/minute; unidentified (IP only): 10/minute; authenticated established editors: 2000/minute; bot-flagged accounts and Cloud Services exempt. Applies to the Action API and REST APIs across Wikimedia sites.

provenance.notes: Rate limits page (2026-11-10): per-minute limits enforced per user; 200/minute declared for an unauthenticated client with a compliant User-Agent (10/minute if unidentified); concurrent requests 3 or fewer; 429 or 503 with Retry-After, else wait at least 5 s or back off. User-Agent policy (foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:User-Agent_policy): '<client name>/<version> (<contact information>)', contact as e-mail, website or wiki user; missing or generic User-Agents get 403. API:Etiquette: no hard read speed limit but be considerate; requests in series rather than in parallel; maxlag for non-interactive tasks (example maxlag=1, lower is nicer); batch with '|'; cache what can be cached. Structured data (main, Property, Lexeme, EntitySchema namespaces) CC0; other namespaces' text CC BY-SA 4.0. Images from commons.wikimedia.org carry their own licences. A test call with maxlag=5 returned retry-after: 5, no RateLimit headers.
